title: Optimize cloud sphere tracing with 128x32x128 3D SDF baking
abstract:
Optimized cloud sphere tracing by baking a low-resolution (128x32x128) 3D SDF texture that the marching loop can march against to conservatively skip empty space before falling back to analytical evaluations inside active cells. All unit tests and shader validations passed 100% successfully.
